decisions.subject: NB54361-L
decisions.summary: NB54361-L rejected as cost-down for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2
decisions.reason: Hit thermal shutdown at 68C under full load (TR-112 page 4)

evidence.quote: Closing as Won't Do. Rejected per DEC-117. NB54360 remains the only approved regulator for PSM-28 Rev 2.
Thermal soak per TP-PSM-07 at 70C ambient, sealed enclosure: NB54361-L hit thermal shutdown at 68C under full load. See TR-112 page 4. Not suitable.
